glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形): a nose exhaling. Original form of 呬. Later phonetically borrowed (假借) to represent 四 (“four”). The word "four" was written as 亖 before Western Zhou and 四 appeared in late Spring and Autumn period. This alternative form was used to prevent confusion of 亖 and 二 (“two”) or 三 (“three”) in vertical writing. It was standardized in Qin dynasty.
senses: [sì] (literary) in or from the four directions
